description: This Java class 'ConnectionDeletedStrategies' implements strategies to handle connectivity commands, specifically handling cases where a command is received for a non-existent (deleted) connection. It extends an abstract strategies class, registers specific strategies, and provides behavior for unhandled commands and command definition checks.

classes.name: ConnectionDeletedStrategies
classes.description: Defines strategies for handling connectivity commands related to deleted or non-existent connections, particularly providing a default behavior for unhandled commands which logs a warning and returns an error result.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectionDeletedStrategies.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles commands received for connections that have been deleted; logs a warning and returns an error result indicating the connection is not accessible.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates that the command is always considered defined, primarily for logging purposes.
